_comment: Chapter 3 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): F13, a rescue: the scholar goes home (the village: what Godborn means).

text.zh_TW: 一位學者被埋在書堆裡，只露出一隻手在揮。「救命——不，等等，先別動那本！那是初版！」
text.en: A scholar is buried under a pile of books, one hand waving. "Help! No, wait, don't move that one! It's a first edition!"

text.zh_TW: 學者：「謝謝你，孩子。我看到收集者的名冊了——你的名字旁邊寫著兩個字：『神裔』。回村後來找我，我把我知道的都告訴你。」
text.en: Scholar: "Thank you, child. I saw the Collectors' ledger. Next to your name there was one word: 'Godborn'. Come and find me in the village and I'll tell you all I know."
